en:
3-Wire Expander

Introduction

The triport class is used to configure a 3-Wire Expander, allowing additional 3-Wire ports to be used with the V5 Brain.

Class Constructor

triport(
  int32_t index );

Class Destructor

Destroys the triport object and releases associated resources.

virtual ~triport();

Parameters

Parameter Type Description
index int32_t The Smart Port that the 3-Wire Expander is connected to, written as PORTx, where x is the port number (for example, PORT1).

Examples

// Create a triport instance in Port 1.
triport Expander1 = triport(PORT1);

三线端口扩展器

概述

构造函数

triport(
  int32_t index );

析构函数

销毁triport对象并释放关联资源。

virtual ~triport();

参数

参数 类型 说明
index int32_t 3-Wire Expander 连接的智能端口，写作PORTx，其中x是端口号（例如，PORT1）。

示例
